captureSetup.title: Capture on your Mac
captureSetup.description: LaunchStack Capture records microphone and computer audio locally. No bot joins your call, and this page never asks for microphone access.
captureSetup.ready: Install the Mac app to start capturing calls.
captureSetup.waiting: Open LaunchStack Capture from your Downloads to finish
captureSetup.statusUnavailable: Cannot check your Macs right now. Check your connection; we’ll keep trying.
captureSetup.connectionFailed: Could not connect to LaunchStack Capture. Please try again.
captureSetup.revokeDescription: This Mac will no longer be able to capture calls for your account. You can reconnect it later.
captureSetup.revokeFailed: Could not revoke this Mac. Please try again.

capture.transcriptEmpty: Transcript appears as LaunchStack Capture streams microphone and computer audio after you start capture.
capture.unavailable: No Mac is online. Open LaunchStack Capture on your Mac to start or resume capture.
capture.statusUnavailable: Cannot check your Macs right now. Check your connection and try again.
capture.infoDescription: LaunchStack Capture records microphone and computer audio locally on your Mac. No bot joins the call.
capture.infoPrivacy: Manage your connected Macs in the setup card in All notes. This page never requests browser microphone access.
capture.finalizingDescription: Stopping audio and saving pending transcript segments…
capture.pausedDescription: LaunchStack Capture stopped. The transcript so far is kept. Resume continues this call. Open LaunchStack Capture on an online Mac before you resume.
capture.failedDescription: Capture did not finish successfully. Saved evidence is retained. Check LaunchStack Capture and audio permissions on your Mac before starting again.

feature.loadingDescription: Start a capture when you are ready. LaunchStack Capture handles audio on your Mac; this page does not request browser microphone access.
feature.unavailableDescription: The Call Notes service could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
feature.loadFailed: Call Notes could not be loaded
feature.captureTimedOut: Capture command timed out. Retry to check the same request safely.
